title: L'autre d'antan (Johannes Okeghem)
desc: Johannes Okeghem, L'autre d'antan. 3 voices (Superius, Tenor, Contratenor), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Oke3009); encoded by Jesse Rodin.
